Results.Title: MTC November 2026 - Keeping Warm
Results.Message:
[align=center][img]https://images.mania-exchange.com/banners/mtc-banner-by-keissla.jpg[/img]
[i]Banner by [user]14413[/user][/i][/align]
Autumn has hit. Temperatures fall, and the colors of leaves turn to reds and browns. How about we steal these colors for some race tracks?

The Monthly Track Contest (MTC) is a regularly occurring mapping competition with a new theme each month. Check out the theme details and how to enter by clicking the button below or by heading to the forums.

Results.Title: Temporary degraded service
Results.Message:
We're experiencing some degraded service, likely related to the recent PHP security vulnerabilities, as we and the services we use, are deploying patches.

Until service is restored, you may not be able to upload maps. Also some maps may be unavailable for download.

Thanks for your patience. We hope to restore service soon.

Results.Title: ADVENT CALENDAR PROJECT 2026 - Open for sign-ups!
Results.Message:
[img]https://images.mania-exchange.com/community/acp2025/acp25banner.jpg[/img]

Although we are still in October, its time to think ahead and plan for the annual Advent Calendar Project! A project that aims to give everyone a lovely Christmas-themed map every day in December, until Christmas day. It has been a yearly tradition on TMX, MX and other exchange-sites over the years and we're excited to bring it to you once again.

For a chance to participate, make sure to fill out the form below! After October 18th, we will select 25 mappers (or groups) to be part of this years project.
[url=https://forms.gle/pBf2G1954524uryS8]https://forms.gle/pBf2G1954524uryS8[/url]
